sights.n: Pokémon Center Kyoto (ポケモンセンターキョウト)
sights.address: SUINA Muromachi 2F (Kyoto Economic Center), Shimogyō-ku, Kyoto (direct from Shijō / Karasuma stations)
sights.w: The official Pokémon store in Kyoto, reopened in March 2019 in SUINA Muromachi. A Pikachu dressed as a maiko and the legendary Lugia and Ho-Oh greet visitors, and it sells Kyoto-only goods.
sights.anime: Pokémon — official Pokémon Center with Kyoto-exclusive maiko-Pikachu merchandise.

sights.w: Nintendo's third official store in Japan, after Tokyo and Osaka, which opened on 17 October 2023 in its hometown. It has Mario and warp-pipe statues and Mario, Zelda, Splatoon and Animal Crossing merchandise.
sights.anime: Nintendo (Mario, Zelda, Splatoon) — the company's official store in its home city.

sights.n: Daikichiyama Observation Deck (大吉山展望台, Buttoku-san)
sights.address: Daikichiyama Fūchi Park, Uji, Kyoto Prefecture
sights.w: The lookout on Daikichiyama (officially Buttoku-san, 131.6 m) above the Uji river, with a view over all of Uji. It is a stamp point on the Keihan × Sound! Euphonium rally.
sights.anime: Sound! Euphonium (Kyoto Animation) — the observation deck where the protagonist and her friend play, in both the novel and the anime.
